numbers.binary64: Exactly 16 lowercase hex digits, finite IEEE754 binary64 bits; preserve negative zero. No NaN/Infinity. Explicit arithmetic uses f64 and original reduction order.
numbers.integers: Canonical signed i128 and unsigned u128 decimal strings; no plus, leading zero, or signed -0. Source ordinal canonical u64 string. Lossless transport is distinct from number_f64 conversion to binary64 for reviewed reduction arithmetic.
numbers.rendering: Ordered JSON numeric lexemes preserve native profile bytes; never ordinary JS JSON.parse/stringify when it changes integer precision or negative zero/lexemes.

time.policy: epoch_seconds canonical signed i64 string, nanoseconds 0..999999999; nullable source offset and required native calendar offset. Order epoch seconds, nanos, source ordinal; owner_date explicit YYYY-MM-DD with year 1..9998 and roundtrip canonical validation. Calendar timezone supplied IANA; Date/number cannot replace exact tuple.

rechunking.policy: Stable record ID/retention token based on owner date and native identity, never batch index/position; strictly ascending source ordinal; owner dates ascending per batch, nondecreasing across batches with boundary-date repetition allowed; duplicate IDs reject. Transactional invalid batches do not advance expected index.
rechunking.fixture_case: apple-required-differentials exercises merged versus two-batch output comparison

cancellation.policy: Semantic checks before parsing, every 64 records and before reduction; idempotent observed cancellation clears records, returns terminal cancelled/no days; later calls semantic_session_terminal. Render batches stage then commit only on valid noncancelled inputs; terminal cancellation/completion preserved.

selection_and_reduction.policy: Profile registry selector/projection validation; native SDK aggregates singular and not rebuilt; direct/dependency attribution preserved; disabled outputs filtered; paired BP requires both selectors; BMI calculation-only dependencies retained without leaking own outputs; latest exact time/ordinal; workouts explicit duration weighting; missing differs from zero; lower later VO2 remains latest.

unicode_paths.collision_key: NFKC then full case folding then NFKC
unicode_paths.limits: Path <=4096 UTF-8 bytes; media type <=128 ASCII bytes. Source does not impose a separate per-component byte bound.
unicode_paths.rejection: Empty, absolute POSIX/Windows drive, trailing slash, backslash, NUL/control, unresolved braces, empty/dot/dotdot component; duplicate/collision keys rejected; destination roots remain native.

exact_policies.serialization: Semantic result canonical UTF-8 compact recursively sorted object keys; arrays retain order. Public profile bytes preserve key/number order, escaping, omission, exact delimiters/newlines and hashes. Stream RFC4180Rows uses CRLF. Managed Markdown merge renderer revision 2 preserves complete YAML property blocks and distinguishes plain typed from quoted string keys; ambiguous ownership fails.

bounds.stream_policy: Synchronous pull one bounded raw chunk/JSON-array item/RFC4180 row per call; retain sequence/hash/count only; final descriptor hashes concatenated bytes including closing frame; planned api_post streams rejected. Native spool backpressure and deployed host memory remain unqualified.
